T: Roll up. Roll up. Dinner is served.
D: A dreamer from nothing builds a dazzling circus show in 1800s New York.
P: Serve the snacks when the ringmaster opens the show.
S: the big top on opening night
Peanuts in the shell roasted at 180C for 20 minutes, tossed hot with salt and a little smoked paprika, served in paper cones.
the crowd pouring into the tent
Popcorn tossed in a brown sugar and butter caramel with a pinch of bicarb and salt, baked at 120C for 45 minutes, stirred every 15.
Apples on sticks dipped in a red toffee of sugar, water and golden syrup boiled to 150C, set on oiled baking paper.
M: the toast after the first sold-out show
Beef sirloin roasted at 200C to 52C, rested, carved, with Yorkshire puddings, roast potatoes and a red wine gravy.
Chicken breasts pan-roasted in butter, a white wine and tarragon cream sauce, buttered new potatoes and green beans.
W: Red velvet layer cake baked at 175C, layered and covered in cream cheese frosting, gold sprinkles on top.
K: the bar where the partnership is agreed
Champagne poured into coupes, or sparkling apple juice for the younger crowd.

s.note: the big top on opening night
s.how: Spread 400g peanuts in the shell on a tray and roast at 180C for 20 minutes. Toss hot with flaky salt and a little smoked paprika. Roll paper into cones and fill them up.

s.note: the crowd pouring into the tent
s.how: Pop 120g kernels. Boil 150g brown sugar, 80g butter and 3 tbsp golden syrup for 4 minutes, then stir in half a tsp bicarb and a pinch of salt. Pour over, toss and bake at 120C for 45 minutes, stirring every 15.

m.note: the toast after the first sold-out show
m.how: Roast a 1.5kg sirloin at 200C until 52C inside and rest. Roast 1kg potatoes. Whisk 3 eggs, 150g flour and 300ml milk and bake in hot oiled tins at 220C for 20 minutes. Reduce 200ml red wine with the pan juices for gravy.

w.how: Beat 125g butter and 250g sugar, add 2 eggs, then fold in 250g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp cocoa, 250ml buttermilk and red colouring. Bake in two tins at 175C for 30 minutes. Layer and cover with 250g cream cheese beaten with 250g icing sugar. Add gold sprinkles.

d.note: the bar where the partnership is agreed
d.how: Chill a 750ml bottle of champagne and a 750ml bottle of sparkling apple juice. Pour into coupes, bubbles for the grown-ups and apple for the younger crowd. Raise them to the show.
